acceptance: Condenser datasheet and HEI calculation approved
text: Thermal design per HEI Standards for Steam Surface Condensers (11th edition or later): cleanliness factor 0.85, 5 % tube plugging margin, tube velocity 1.8 m/s to 2.2 m/s, titanium wall per HEI. Hotwell storage at least 3 minutes of maximum condensate flow; dissolved oxygen at hotwell outlet <= 20 ug/l in normal operation.
title: Condenser design standard
